title: Why they made him leader
summary: He thinks it was because he did most of the writing and solos, naming tunes like 'Hawk Swing' and 'Hawk Squawk'.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay. So, after a couple of months, you became the leader of the band.
And, what kind of reasons did they have for making you the leader?

Well, all I can say that, they just, they just wanted me to be. Maybe, maybe, I was doing most of the playing. You know, jazz parts, and I was doing writing. And everything I composed myself the name, the name had to be something like 'Hawk Swing,' 'Hawk Squawk.' Everything, everything I made part of my name. You know?
And then the bands in city was, I let them have some compositions of mine. So, I think maybe that's one of the
reasons cause of me writing, and then doing mostly all the solos.
